title: Event lineage curation and SCD-backed curated tables for Console usage analytics
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our Console usage analytics currently relies on ad-hoc event snapshots and denormalized aggregates that are not traceable to source events. This causes divergence between product telemetry and billing/usage reports, complicates incident triage, and makes time-travel/late-arriving data corrections risky.

Goal: Build a curated, lineage-first layer in the warehouse that: 1) materializes stable fact tables for console usage, 2) retains source event lineage for auditability, and 3) applies SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) semantics for user/workspace metadata so historical aggregates are reproducible. Deliver a set of L2 curated tables and a documented ingestion pattern for downstream analytics and BI consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Schema design doc for event_lineage and usage_fact tables reviewed and merged to Confluence (link included)
ETL jobs deployed that populate event_lineage (append-only with provenance columns) and usage_fact (daily/rollup) using SCD2 for workspace/user dims
Backfill strategy defined and run for last 90 days with reconciliation within 0.5% vs existing dashboards
Row-level lineage columns (source_event_id, ingestion_timestamp, original_payload_hash) present in final tables
Dashboards updated to point to curated usage_fact; at least two key owner sign-offs (Analytics PM + Console Product)
Automated sanity checks and a monitoring alert for late-arriving events triggered when >1% of daily events are missing
activity_log: 2025-02-11 - Kickoff: Reviewed current event sources (api-gateway, console-client, backend-traces). Agreed single canonical event schema with teams: console-backend and ingestion (notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/console-analytics/event-lineage-v1)

2025-02-14 - Design review: Chose SCD2 for workspace/user dims to preserve historical joins; trade-off: increased storage but enables exact historical rollups. Marco noted potential performance hit on joins; plan to precompute denormalized keys in nightly job.
2025-02-18 - Implementation: Created initial dbt models for event_lineage (append-only) and usage_fact (daily aggregation). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics/pull/412 (in review).

2025-02-20 - Data validation: Ran spot reconciliation for 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-10. Discrepancy 0.37% vs previous pipeline. Noted edge-case from legacy session events — added mapping rule to normalize event types.
2025-02-23 - Ops: Added instrumentation to emit original_payload_hash and ingestion_timestamp at ingestion time. Updated deployment playbook and rollback steps in runbook (internal doc link)
2025-02-25 - Blocker discovered: Late-arriving events from EU region delayed due to timezone partitioning; investigating fix to ingestion watermarking. Assigned hotfix ticket ENG-34755.
